items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: I've been in that two years with John.

ctx.x: Ask him who he was on the radio with.

Then when they quit him, they go get the lawyer. And the lawyer kind of said, I got that $150 you were buying from John Tucker. He said, I've been in that two years with John. You know, he said, it's been over $15. I said, I bet you. I got a radio. He said, who was you on the radio with? A radio? A radio. A radio. A radio. A radio. A radio. A radio. A radio. A radio. A radio. A radio. A radio. A radio.
